description: This file defines an abstract class for Ludo AI strategies and two implementations (_EasyAi and _MediumAi). It also includes a factory method to select an AI based on difficulty, and methods for AI move selection logic.

classes.name: LudoAi
classes.description: Abstract class defining AI behavior for selecting moves in Ludo.

classes.name: LudoAiStrategies
classes.description: Class providing a factory method to get AI implementations based on difficulty.

classes.name: _EasyAi
classes.description: AI implementation making random move choices.

classes.name: _MediumAi
classes.description: AI implementation with logic to prefer capturing moves when available.

methods.name: selectMove
methods.description: Abstract method to select a move from legal moves, given game state and dice roll, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: forDifficulty
methods.description: Factory method that returns an AI strategy instance for the specified difficulty level.
